prompt: Stage 3-1, level 5, 30 gold, 8 XP from level 6, 77 HP. A 2-star caster is on the bench and would be your sixth unit. You get 2 XP free at the start of every round and can buy 4 XP for 4 gold at any time. What gets six units into this fight, and what does it cost?

options.label: Buy XP twice (8 gold): 8 XP reaches level 6 now and the caster fights this round
Buy XP once (4 gold) now and once next round: same 8 gold, spread out
Wait for the free 2 XP a round: you reach level 6 without spending anything

explanation:
XP is bought in blocks of 4 for 4 gold. You need 8, so two purchases, 8 gold, and you are level 6 before the fight with the 2-star caster on the board. 30 gold becomes 22, which still pays 2 interest, and the free 2 XP next round starts you toward level 7. Level 6 at 3-1 is a round ahead of the usual 3-2, which is fine when the sixth unit is already a 2-star.

Spreading the buys costs the same 8 gold but the caster misses this fight, and with the free 2 XP arriving next round you would end up at 6 at 3-2 having spent 8 gold anyway. Waiting for free XP takes four rounds (2 a round for 8) and you reach 6 at 3-5, three fights late, to save 8 gold. A fight lost in stage 3 costs more HP than 8 gold buys back.
principle: 4 gold buys 4 XP. Count the XP you are missing, divide by four, and that is the price of the extra unit.
commonMistake: Buying XP one click at a time across rounds and arriving a level short of the lobby for the fights that mattered.
hint: Work out how many XP purchases 8 XP needs and how many rounds the free 2 XP would take instead.
